rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=214, epochs=40, batch_size=4, lr=0.0005, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). ONE KNOB: epochs 10->40 (4x). SIX-BOX: (1) iter-1 SSIM 0.8859 / hr 0.173 / PSNR 35.73, full iter elapsed 328.96s (~5.5 min) vs HARD 20-min train+score budget -> uswin used only ~1/4 of budget. (2) UNDER-TRAINED: 10 epochs in 5.5 min; proven campaign lever (epochs+ lifted dual_domain_supervised 0.276->0.339, itnet_v3 0.268->0.310 in this same 20-min budget); discarded-run hint ~0.97 SSIM with epochs the lever. (3) Change EXACTLY ONE knob: epochs 10->40; ALL else fixed (train_n=200, bs=4, lr=5e-4, uswin_c=24, window=8, heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). max_train_s=1000 (16.7 min) is the HARD train backstop so even if 40 epochs do not finish, train stops at the cap and ALWAYS leaves >=3 min for the 214-slice val score + figure inside the 30-min wall -> train+score stays <=20 min. (4) HYPOTHESIS: uswin is epochs-limited at ep10; 4x epochs lifts hr above 0.173 toward/past dual_domain_supervised. FALSIFIER: hr <= 0.173 at ep40 -> uswin is NOT epochs-limited in budget, iter-3 pivots to lr or uswin_c. (5) HARD 20-min budget, val=ALL 214 L277 slices (val_n NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (default, no fov=False), staged_canonical v3, per-sample-ps, bg_target=truth. (6) no control return.
